description: This file defines the PHP class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_mailto, which handles validation and configuration specific to mailto URI schemes within the HTML Purifier library. It extends a base URI scheme class to implement email URI validation according to RFC 2368.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_mailto
classes.description: Handles validation and configuration for mailto URI schemes within the HTML Purifier library.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates the mailto URI according to RFC 2368, resetting user info, host, and port components.
